data: SIMULATED (Nova Bazaar is fictional); not field results
primary_arm: TimesFM (BigQuery AI.FORECAST) + festival calendar; demand_sensed = sales + captured unmet / capture rate
window: cutoff 2025-09-08, 42-day horizon to 2025-10-19 (Diwali 2025 = 2025-10-20), chain-wide (7 stores x 6 categories)
sensitivity_note: Across capture rates of 10-50%, demand sensing cuts lost revenue by 9.6-11.3% and WAPE by 1.1-1.4 points versus sales-only, with gains growing as more unmet demand is captured (simulation; capture rate assumed known).
